| core_ctrl | Host loading, image/frame validity, stage sequence, output transfer, completion code | All N output transfers accepted, or one held error report | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| embedding_ctrl | Token loop, FEATURE-to-TOKEN copy, norm/linear/norm calls, VECTOR-to-X copy | All X writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| position_ctrl | m/n/feature loops, P/E reads, widened additions/conversions | All enriched X writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| encoder_ctrl | k loop, layer-specific parameter descriptor | K successful layer responses accepted | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| final_ctrl | Token loop, D-to-1 linear calls | L LOGIT values committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| aggregation_ctrl | n/m loops, per-position sum/count, reciprocal/scale, private output writes | All N writes committed, or typed empty-position/fatal response | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| layer_ctrl | LN1 sweep, attention, residual1 sweep, LN2 sweep, FFN/residual2 token loop | All second-residual X writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| attention_ctrl | QKV phase, head/query loops, query-mask read, score/softmax/weighted sequence, output projection | All ATTN_OUT writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| ffn_ctrl | First linear, 4D GELU read/replace loop, second linear | D VECTOR outputs committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| residual_ctrl | Element loop, capture both operands, add/convert/write | All requested destination sums committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| qkv_ctrl | Projection selection Q then KEY then VALUE; token loop | All three LD projection arrays committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| score_row_ctrl | Key loop for one fixed head/query, dot/scale, SCORE writes | One complete L-element score row committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.

| softmax_ctrl | Max pass, exp/store/sum pass, reciprocal, probability write pass or uniform bypass | All L probability writes committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| weighted_value_ctrl | Feature loop within fixed head/query, probability-by-V dots | d Z components committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
| output_projection_ctrl | Token loop, Z-to-ATTN_OUT linear calls | All ATTN_OUT tokens committed | Planned processing/control RTL; port contract exists; arithmetic calibration deferred.
